fixtureNotes: FA Cup third round: January 2027, opponent decided by the draw in early December.
Champions League knockout dates depend on where Liverpool finish in the league phase (top 8 go straight to the round of 16 in March; 9th–24th play a February play-off).

injuries.detail: He missed the 4-0 win over Manchester United with a heel problem that is about managing pain rather than a set recovery. He could be fit enough for Club Brugge if the pain allows.
He picked up a soleus (calf) injury on Netherlands duty and has not trained with Liverpool since. He was absent from the Manchester United matchday squad and is expected to miss Club Brugge.
He is back in team training after knee surgery but is still listed as unavailable. Liverpool will load him back in carefully.
He is training with the squad after a serious ACL injury and is not yet available. Iraola hopes he can play in some weeks.
He is still recovering from an Achilles rupture from April. Iraola says the plan remains a return in January 2027, with an earlier return possible if all goes well.
He is listed as unavailable with a knee problem in the Manchester United team news. No return date has been given in that report.
